property.name: hbase.wal.provider
property.description: The default asyncfs WAL provider uses reflection against Hadoop's internal protobuf classes to work across Hadoop versions, and that reflection breaks between this exact Hadoop 3.3.6 / HBase 2.5.15 pairing (IllegalArgumentException: object is not an instance of declaring class, in FanOutOneBlockAsyncDFSOutputHelper/ProtobufDecoder). The classic synchronous filesystem provider avoids that code path entirely.
